description: This file defines WebSocket extension handling, including parsing and negotiating compression extensions such as permessage-deflate and x-webkit-deflate-frame, for the uWS WebSocket library.

classes.name: ExtensionsParser
classes.description: Parses WebSocket extension tokens and parameters from extension headers.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Extracts a token from the extension header string.

methods.name: ExtensionsParser (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes parser with extension header data and sets extension flags.
